description: Reads the caller's own simulated 100k portfolio: cash, NAV, exposure, positions with P&L, open brackets and recent fills. Reading it is also what SETTLES brackets against the last close. Marks are lagged, not live. Analyst plan.

include_history.description: Include the whole trade log and the daily NAV series, both covering the last 30 days. Default false (10 most recent fills, no series).

name: get_paper_account
